channel.title: Tong's Information - Demo (English)
channel.description: A fully static, zero-build, agent-authored bilingual publication exploring interfaces, system architecture, information design, and publishing in the agent era.

item.title: The Dual-Audience Web: Publishing for Human Eyes and AI Agents
item.description: An architectural blueprint for dual-surface static publishing, complete with a live Human/Agent Representation Inspector and a Swiss Modular Grid Workbench.

item.title: Quiet Interfaces: Designing Beyond the Click
item.description: An inquiry into chrome fatigue and intent-driven surfaces, complete with a live Interface Noise-to-Signal Calibrator.

item.title: Thinking in Stereo: Writing Beyond Monolingual Boundaries
item.description: Why maintaining idiomatic Chinese and English editions sharpens thought itself — featuring a margin double-click gesture that unfolds each paragraph's counterpart language in place.

item.title: Readable in Ten Years: Static HTML and the Half-Life of Digital Work
item.description: Measuring the half-life of personal publishing stacks across a ten-year horizon, from dynamic CMS databases to zero-dependency static HTML on the edge.

item.title: Beyond Templates: Why Personal Publishing Belongs to Agent-Authored HTML
item.description: The founding thesis of Tong's Information: separating structural order from creative layout to achieve a zero-framework, entropy-resistant, agent-bilingual static publication.
